reviews.title: The Falou Ultra ads never stop — AFTER PAYING
reviews.text:
As soon as I paid 50 bucks for a subscription after a pressure sale or they offered me a discount and I impulsively bought it, I heard a terrible AI voice speaking in bad English and mispronouncing the word “Falou” half the time saying FAH-loo and other times saying FAY-low. It’s like an AI grandma character who doesn’t even care enough about her own app to know how it’s pronounced. Ick factor 500.

But that’s not the worst part. After every lesson, they disrupt my immersion with this terrible creepy English to tel me to upgrade to their higher tier paid plan, “Falou Ultra” so I can use their AI chat. I don’t want AI chat, I don’t need AI chat. I have people to practice speaking with in real life. It is disgusting that I cannot turn off these ads, and it is completely ruining the product experience. I already paid $50 and I’m on an annual subscription that renews for a lot more than that. Leave me alone with the ads.

reviews.title: Very nice for beginners
reviews.text:
I love that it offers explanations and is very user friendly. The speech detector can be a little finicky sometimes. I don’t like that I cannot review previous lessons and choose which sections to review again. The ‘all words’ review gets a little repetitive, for example, if I elect to practice previous words/phrases back to back, the practice is often the same as the first pass versus different phrases and words in my list. I get this will be repetitive in the beginning based on amount of words one has, but I’m up to 85/90 now, and I seem to still get the same lesson each time. 

Overall, the explanations make this app stand out to competitors.

“ It is the thing of the work on the desk” 
(¿뭐?)

“It is the time for the desk key” 
(¿진짜?)

“I like the key that sees that”
(¿설마 농담하시는 거죠?)

“ Yesterday I went near the subway station and did the things on the desk”. 
(¡이것이야말로 터무니없음의 극치입니다!

I screen shot it to post here but I don’t think it will let me. I’ll try it on Google. 

COME ON FALOU. THIS IS TOTALLY UNACCEPTABLE 

I canceled my subscription. 
I’m not paying for this foolery.

reviews.title: Too many grammatical errors
reviews.text: I was really enjoying this app, even paid for the premium and I regret it now. I had previous knowledge in the language that I am learning and started noticing grammatically incorrect sentences. Now I have a hard time trusting what I am learning because when it becomes more advanced I will probably not notice that what I am being thought is incorrect.

reviews.title: Aspiring polyglot
reviews.text: I like Falou because it offers languages other apps don’t and it helps a lot with pronunciation. I just wish you could study more than one language at a time in your profile or drop down bar rather than just switching. The most popular language app offers this feature and I like it a lot. It helps me keep better track of my daily progress across several different languages.
